zh-CN.name: 微信支付 Skills
zh-CN.shortDesc: 微信支付官方接入技能包：产品选型、官方示例代码、编码接入、接入质量评估与答疑排障。需联网同步官方知识库，并使用 Node.js 20+ 与 npm 安装的官方 CLI；查单与签名验签实测需用户自己的商户授权和凭据，并经明确同意。

en-US.name: WeChat Pay Skills
en-US.shortDesc: Official WeChat Pay integration skills: product selection, sample code, coding integration, quality review and troubleshooting. Syncs the official knowledge base online and uses Node.js 20+ with the npm-installed official CLI; live queries and signature tests need the operator's own merchant authorization, credentials and explicit consent.
